blocks.text: Collect and showcase testimonials that drive conversions

Senja solves the operational challenge of testimonial management. Collecting testimonials is awkward - you need to ask at the right time, make it easy to respond, and then organize and display the results. Senja automates this entire process.

The collection flow is designed to maximize response rates. Send a branded request via email or link, and respondents can leave text or video testimonials in a guided flow. The questions are customizable, and the experience is professional enough that customers do not feel like they are being put on the spot.

The display options are what convert social proof into revenue. Embed testimonial walls, carousel widgets, or individual quotes on your website - all styled to match your brand. The right testimonial on the right landing page can be the difference between a bounce and a conversion.
Branded testimonial request forms for text and video
Record video testimonials directly from the collection form
Embeddable walls, carousels, and quotes styled to your brand
Pull existing testimonials from G2, Capterra, Twitter, and LinkedIn
Tag and categorize testimonials by product, feature, or use case
Social proof is the most underutilized conversion tool for most startups. Senja makes it easy to collect, manage, and display testimonials - turning happy customers into a conversion engine.
Our team can integrate Senja into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
